caption:
This will change your Chester weekends: 3 farm stops, all with a Chester address.

Alstede Farms at 1 Alstede Farms Ln has a farm store open daily, pick-your-own fields (buy tickets online first) and cider donuts. Stony Hill Farms at 15 North Rd has a farm market, U-pick apples and pumpkins in season and a corn maze, open daily through Dec. 23. Riamede Farm at 122 Oakdale Rd is a pick-your-own apple orchard with a pumpkin patch. Its 2026 fall season ends Nov. 1, and it's closed Tuesdays.

Before you make an offer in Chester, drive your weekday commute from the house at rush hour.
